queries.result: First-party discovery found Matsuyama City's official cadastral-survey/results page, its public e~yo Machi Navi map portal, and the Geospatial Information Authority/Ministry of Justice registry-map dataset catalog for Matsuyama (municipality code 38201). The city map portal documents public administrative map viewing but no cadastral parcel API was verified.

sourceAssessment.officialCityService: Matsuyama City e~yo Machi Navi public administrative map portal; city documentation describes map viewing/search for administrative information, but an anonymous cadastral parcel service was not exposed in the inspected page.
sourceAssessment.localRegistryProcedure: Matsuyama City official cadastral-survey page documents city-held cadastral results and fee-based viewing/application for eligible districts; this is local institutional custody and procedure evidence, not a public anonymous runtime parcel API.
sourceAssessment.openGeometrySource: G-Space CKAN catalog record aigid-moj-38201, Ministry of Justice registry-office map extract for Matsuyama, with 2022-2026 GeoJSON resources. The 2026 catalog URL returned a GeoJSON FeatureCollection labelled 2025 and was inspected as published.

fieldMapping.ID: stable source feature identity retained as id

sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: The source exposes municipality/area/lot fields, but no composite key was used because the stable source ID field ID was present. Retained GeoJSON contains only ID-derived id.
sourceAssessment.crs: CRS84; source coordinates are longitude, latitude and retained GeoJSON follows RFC 7946.
sourceAssessment.sampleScope: One source polygon intersected the exact unchanged WUP point in a bounded 0.0000003-degree query window; one polygon is retained as a safe-ID geometry sample. This is not a citywide completeness claim.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Matsuyama municipality in the published Ministry of Justice registry-map extract; bounded local query only.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The catalog record and published GeoJSON were verified, and one exact-point intersecting feature was observed. Dataset completeness, public-coordinate coverage, and cadastral status by parcel remain unvalidated.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official cadastral-survey page; documents survey products, district coverage, viewing/application and city custody; no parcel API exposed.
Official public map portal; page describes administrative-information maps, but no cadastral parcel layer/API was verified from the public HTML.
Official FAQ links the e~yo Machi Navi map and states public map use for urban-planning information; it does not expose cadastral geometry.
Catalog metadata returned Matsuyama 2022-2026 GeoJSON/SHP resources and source schema metadata.
Published GeoJSON fetched to ignored scratch; CRS84, Polygon features, native ID field present. Bounded source filtering around exact WUP point returned one feature ID H000002385.

blocker: A real public source-native geometry and stable ID were verified, including an exact-point hit, but the official city viewer's live configuration/API and citywide completeness were not independently qualified for runtime integration.
remainingUncertainty: The published registry-map extract may have incomplete or varying cadastral coverage; the exact source-version label is inconsistent (catalog resource named 2026 while fetched FeatureCollection name is 2025); no owner, address, lot, title, or other unsafe fields were retained.
nextStep: If runtime qualification is required, inspect the official map portal's current JavaScript/configuration and independently validate source coverage and adapter behavior; retain geometry and safe native IDs only.
identityPolicy: Retain only the stable native source ID as id with geometry; do not expose Japanese lot/address or person/property fields.
